material_findings: DarwinX held-out recombination is not monotone: specialist union covers 29/41 TerminalWorld tasks while realized merge solves 28/41, adding one task no parent solves but losing two parent-solved tasks; merge must itself be treated as a candidate

Salesforce fragility study shows ground-truth endpoint reward still yields unreliable persistent lessons; task order changes self-improvement outcomes and stronger baselines shrink apparent gains; public RBank/AWM path persists generated memory without a separate behavioral promotion gate

Phantom Guardrails demonstrates a failure class invisible to outcome-only gates: unsupported no-op guardrails can be admitted under accept-if-not-worse and can piggyback in strictly improving batches; an independent evidence/warrant gate blocks phantoms while preserving real fixes in the tested micro-lab

Future-Feedback Prediction shows a verifiable offline route for moving targets by evolving a fixed-label observational diagnostic, while explicitly requiring fresh validation before transferring that diagnostic into behavior-changing edits
